terms.gloss: today, nowadays, at the present day
evidence: Cic. Lael. 43: quālis hodiē sit (Lewis & Short)
terms.comment: Hodiēque, still today, is post-Augustan (Plin. NH 16.15; Lewis & Short).

phrases.latin: quod ego fuī ad Trasumennum, ad Cannās, id tū hodiē es
phrases.english: what I was at Trasimene and at Cannae, you are today

phrases.latin: quīn et hodiēque per Hispāniās secundīs mēnsīs glāns īnseritur
phrases.english: why, even today acorns are served as dessert all over Spain

sources: Lewis & Short: hodie · Lewis & Short: nunc · Lewis & Short: aetas
